content.title: About
content.content: A pork sandwich is a classic handheld meal consisting of a slice of bread topped with thin slices of boiled or smoked pork ham, often complemented by mustard, mayonnaise, lettuce, and tomato. It is popular as a quick snack or light lunch.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first recorded pork sandwich dates back to the 19th century in England.
Ham in a sandwich is frequently paired with cheddar or Swiss cheese.
In the United States, versions with cranberry sauce are popular during the holiday season.
Ham can be homemade or store‑bought, which influences flavor and salt content.
Pork sandwiches are a staple in school cafeterias and at sporting events.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Ham provides high‑quality animal protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Ham contains thiamine, niacin, and vitamin B12, which support energy metabolism and nervous system health.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: The iron in ham helps maintain hemoglobin levels and prevents anemia.

items.title: Low in carbohydrates
items.content: A pork sandwich fits low‑carb diets when made with whole‑grain or low‑carb bread.

items.title: Provides zinc
items.content: Zinc from ham supports immune function and wound healing.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Ham is often salty; excess sodium can raise blood pressure.

items.title: Preservatives and nitrites
items.content: Some hams contain nitrites, which can form potentially harmful compounds when overheated.

items.title: Meat allergy
items.content: A small number of people may experience allergic reactions to meat proteins.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: The sandwich can be calorie‑rich, especially with mayonnaise and fatty bread.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: A pork sandwich is easy to eat with your hands. Slice it in half, add lettuce, cucumber, mustard or your favorite sauce. For a heartier version, use whole‑grain bread and add avocado.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the assembled sandwich in the refrigerator in an airtight container for up to 24 hours. Keep ham separately wrapped in plastic film at 0‑4 °C and use within 3‑5 days.
